errors.note: A candidate launch (runtime_options.mob_composition.authority = candidate) calls no member's tool; resolving and reading an app stay open.

read_only.applicability: HTTP console methods classified as mutating, including multipart send/upload. This is not the structural mob-events stale-cursor meaning of -32010; discriminate by method and data.

access_denied.applicability: Applicable ABAC action gates and access-administration checks. Additional denial context may be present. Some reads filter results instead of refusing the whole request; this is not an unconditional error on every method.

candidate_launch.applicability: A runtime-backed console of a candidate launch (runtime_options.mob_composition.authority = candidate) refuses, before anything is read or written, the methods that retire, respawn or reset a member, recompute the roster or rewire members (meta/retire, meta/retire_member, meta/respawn, meta/respawn_member, meta/reset, meta/reset_all, meta/delete_identity, meta/reconcile_identity and meta/topology/apply; meta/reconcile_edges answers a dry run flagged applied: false instead), meta/gating/decide, the ones that create a session (meta/ensure_member, meta/spawn_helper, meta/fork_helper and meta/attach_existing_session), the ones that admit member input or act on a member's runs (among them meta/console/send, including multipart, meta/console/voice/open, meta/console/recover_send, meta/run_flow, meta/reload_member, meta/stop_member_run and meta/force_cancel_member), the member declaration mutations (mob/adopt_member_identity_declaration and mob/apply_member_tool_declaration), and the operator mutations: the WorkGraph writes, meta/memory/quarantine/decide, the agent memory writes, the label sets and deletes, the access policy writes, meta/console/revoke_sessions, meta/blob/upload, meta/cancel_flow, the live channel verbs, a mobpack deploy with execute or a validation with rkat_validate, and a draft write (meta/mobpacks/create, save, delete, undo and redo) except to a store file the caller names outside the state directory and the gateway home that is not the store META_FLOW_EDITOR_DRAFT_STORE names. Reads still answer.

rpc.policy_error_inventory: policy_error_refs supplement each endpoint or method's local errors array. Endpoint references are conditional on the dispatched method, not all requests.

console_multipart_rpc_endpoint.policy_note: Both supported methods are read-only gated. The agent.send ABAC gate applies to meta/console/send, not standalone meta/blob/upload.

If type is supplied as a string it must be image_upload; media_type, when supplied as a string, must equal the file part's MIME type.

multipart.file_part: Exactly one file:<upload_id-or-part_name> part matching the selected identifier

request.note: run_id is the member run's UUID from its run_started event (identity.run_id). A stale run_id is the typed not_current receipt, never an interrupt.

success.note: receipt is meerkat's WireRunStopReceipt, tagged by outcome: stopped { run_id, contributors }, not_current { run_id, current_run_id? } or not_stoppable { run_id, state }.

errors.note: Mob refusals (unknown member, unsupported member mode, host refusal) carry meerkat's typed code and structured data.

request.note: HTTP returns a bounded snapshot without cursor pagination. SDK/stdin additionally accepts recipient/sink filters and defaults limit to 20.

success.note: decision.review records the verdict, reviewer, bound hash, quarantine reason and rationale, plus expired_promotions (gated promotions past their expiry) and invalidated_promotions (live gated promotions an operator tombstone invalidated in the same transaction).

errors.note: -32043 is a typed refusal (data.kind memory_quarantine_review_refused, data.reason not_found | content_mismatch | not_quarantined | gate_pending | successor_conflict | secret_detected | stale_update); nothing was written. gate_pending refuses a release while a live gated promotion owns the record; an operator tombstone invalidates the promotion instead.
